question.question_text: What were the prerequisite steps followed by the camera wearer before adding mushrooms to the dish?

answer_options.text: Wash, cut, and prepare mushrooms on the chopping board, stir onions and peppers in the pot, tap the cooking stick to remove excess food, and adjust the cooker settings.
Wash, cut, and prepare mushrooms on the chopping board, stir onions in the pot, and adjust the cooker settings.
Wash, cut, and prepare mushrooms on the chopping board, stir onions and garlic in the pot, tap the cooking stick to remove excess food, and lower the cooker settings.
Wash, cut, and prepare mushrooms on the chopping board, stir onions in the pot, tap the cooking stick to remove excess food, and adjust the cooker settings.
Rinse, slice, and prepare mushrooms on the chopping board, stir onions in the pot, tap the cooking stick to remove excess food, and set the cooker settings.

shared_investigation.established_facts: The camera wearer washed, cut, and prepared mushrooms on the chopping board. They also stirred the pot with a wooden spoon and adjusted the cooker settings. Additionally, they tapped the cooking stick to remove excess food.
